description: This file defines the ApplicationCostProfilerClient class which extends AwsClient to interact with the AWS Application Cost Profiler service. It includes method annotations for various synchronous and asynchronous operations related to report definitions and application usage.

classes.name: ApplicationCostProfilerClient
classes.description: Client class for AWS Application Cost Profiler service, inherits from AwsClient.

methods.name: deleteReportDefinition
methods.description: Deletes a report definition in AWS Application Cost Profiler.

methods.name: getReportDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves a report definition from AWS Application Cost Profiler.

methods.name: importApplicationUsage
methods.description: Imports application usage data into AWS Application Cost Profiler.

methods.name: putReportDefinition
methods.description: Creates or updates a report definition.
